comment: Independent uhitm.c flash_hits_mon() witness: a Tourist walks beside a doorway, creates eight small mimics with a count before ^G (one takes the doorway and looks like a closed door), and flashes her expensive camera at it. mhidden_description() gets only MHID_ALTMON (uhitm.c 6361), so C prints "That closed door is really a small mimic!" with no prefix or article. The seed, clock, character and input were chosen for this branch.
